summary: Updated implementation plan to fix the silent ANCS notification/call drop on OnePlus Watch 2R + iPhone 14: adds automatic post-bond ANCS CCCD re-subscription waves (+3s/+8s) and onServiceChanged handling, fixes the AncsPacketParser attribute length deadlock and Control Point queue overlap, adds immediate 8-byte Notification Source fallback alerts for calls and messages, and adds live on-watch NS/DS packet telemetry plus an on-watch Re-Sync & Test Alert trigger.
